articles.title: Why I Switched from Express to NestJS in Production (And What 4 Years Taught Me)
articles.excerpt: Every Node.js developer loves Express. It is minimalistic, unopinionated, and takes less than 10 lines of code to get an HTTP server running. When I started my backend career, Express was my weapon of…
articles.body: Every Node.js developer loves Express. It is minimalistic, unopinionated, and takes less than 10 lines of code to get an HTTP server running. When I started my backend career, Express was my weapon of choice. But in 2022, as our backend at MedPiper scaled across enterprise healthcare integrations, financial reporting, and dozens of third-party APIs, our Express codebase started showing its scars: Every new engineer structured their route files differently. Route middleware order was fragile — missing a single authMiddleware in one router file silently left an endpoint unprotected. req.user was mutated arbitrarily across 15 different files, making debugging state bugs an absolute nightmare. Unit testing required heavy monkey-patching because there was no clean dependency injection.

articles.body: When I model an industrial site, I want to separate three things that can look identical on screen: verified data, contextual data, and generated content. Cushing, Oklahoma, is a useful example because the crude oil storage landscape includes many repeated tanks, connecting pipeline corridors, roads, pump equipment, and wider transportation links. A detailed render can make those elements feel equally certain, even when they come from very different sources. I would build an early Cushing scene to answer a bounded question: how does one selected area of the tank district relate to nearby roads and transport infrastructure? I would not use a generated scene to estimate capacity, identify active lines, or make an operational decision. 1.

articles.title: Tamper-evident receipts for AI agent actions: a hash chain in 20 lines
articles.excerpt: When an AI agent spends money, sends an email, or changes a record, someone eventually asks the same question: what exactly did it do, and can I trust this log? A normal log line can be edited after t…
articles.body: When an AI agent spends money, sends an email, or changes a record, someone eventually asks the same question: what exactly did it do, and can I trust this log? A normal log line can be edited after the fact. A receipt that is chained to the one before it cannot be edited quietly. The idea Each action gets a receipt. The receipt holds what was decided, the inputs the agent saw, who approved it, and a timestamp. It also holds the hash of the previous receipt. Change any old receipt and every hash after it stops matching. import hashlib , json , time def seal ( prev_hash : str , action : dict ) -> dict : body = { " ts " : time . time (), " prev " : prev_hash , " action " : action } digest = hashlib . sha256 ( json . dumps ( body , sort_keys = True ). encode ()).

articles.body: 第五讲 · 三候选 DSR 全 FAIL 复盘：超额从哪来，又到哪去了 第二章 · 诚实的验证（第二讲） 学习目标：通过 A 股战役的完整复盘，看懂"排行榜很好看 → 独立验证全灭"的具体机制。 前置：第四讲。 1. 案例背景 A 股战役（2026-09-18~22）结束后，从 290 个因子的排行榜里，按预注册流程选出三个头部候选，送入独立验证管线。判定结果： 三候选 DSR 全部 FAIL。 这一讲的任务是把"全 FAIL"三个字拆开：每个候选的超额看起来从哪来、实际从哪来、验证时死在哪一刀下。 2. 第一刀：DSR——你试了多少次，就要还多少债 回顾第四讲：DSR 对 Sharpe 按试验次数 N 做校正。三个候选来自 290 个因子的排行榜头部，N 不是 3，是 290 （严格说还要算上每个因子的多次评估——第二讲看过， momentum_20d 一个因子就有 23 次评估，全池评估总次数以千计）。 直觉计算：即便候选的原始 Sharpe 在"单次检验"意义下显著，经过千次级别的试验基数校正后，所需门槛被推高到常规数字几乎不可能达到的水平。 这不是门槛苛刻，是事实如此 ——你在千次抛硬币里挑出的最好结果，本来就不该按单次抛硬币的标准评价。 三个候选全部倒在这一关。注意这一刀的 kill 逻辑 ：它不是说"这三个因子必然无效"，而是说" 从千次选拔里胜出的这三个，其成绩不足以证明自己不是运气 "。证据不足，按无罪推定的反面处理：不予采信。 3.

articles.title: The HttpClient Mistake That Can Slow Down Your .NET API
articles.excerpt: An API can run smoothly during development and still struggle when traffic increases. Requests that take milliseconds locally may become much slower in production. Before investigating the database or…
articles.body: An API can run smoothly during development and still struggle when traffic increases. Requests that take milliseconds locally may become much slower in production. Before investigating the database or server resources, it is worth checking how the application makes calls to external services. One common issue is creating a new HttpClient for every outgoing request. ASP.NET Core applications use HttpClient to communicate with payment gateways, authentication providers, third-party APIs, and other backend services. Creating and disposing of a client inside a frequently called method may seem reasonable, but it can prevent efficient connection reuse and contribute to socket exhaustion under heavy load. Let's look at why this happens and how to manage HTTP connections properly in .NET.

articles.title: This upcoming wide-screen slab phone could pack not one, but two 200MP cameras
articles.excerpt: Wide-screen phones could be the next big mid-range hype.
articles.body: TL;DR Oppo is reportedly developing a wide-screen, non-folding smartphone, potentially following Huawei’s Pura X View. The device could feature a 6.35-inch 120Hz display, a Dimensity 9000-series chip, and two 200MP cameras. Two leaks disagree on its positioning, with one pointing to a mid-range Reno device and the other suggesting a pricey flagship. Huawei might have started a trend with its Pura X View . The Chinese tech giant unveiled the device last month, and we were surprised to see its unconventional, passport-like wide form factor. It’s like the Galaxy Z Fold 8 or the iPhone Duo , albeit without the folding mechanism. Now, it looks like other manufacturers are taking notice.

articles.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
articles.excerpt: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 f…
articles.body: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today’s epic patch batch dwarfs September’s record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond. Just one of the weaknesses patched this week is considered a “zero day,” or already exploited in the wild. CVE-2026-96951 is a security feature bypass in the Windows Shell that affects Windows 10 and 11 systems, as well as some Server versions. Windows 10 users might be wondering if they can still expect security updates after this month.

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 13, 1773: Astronomer Charles Messier discovers the Whirlpool Galaxy before we ever knew it was a galaxy
articles.excerpt: On Oct. 13, 1773, a French astronomer named Charles Messier discovered the "Whirlpool Galaxy," also known as Messier 51, or M51. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Oct. 13, 1773, a French astronomer named Charles Messier discovered the " Whirlpool Galaxy , " also known as Messier 51, or M51. Charles Messier was scanning the sky for objects that could confuse comet hunters when he catalogued the galaxy as M51. However, Messier wasn't able to see the spiral structure, and he didn't identify it as a galaxy. Seventy-two years later, another astronomer named William Parsons saw the whirlpool shape, but he thought it was a spiral nebula. Eventually, Edwin Hubble found out that M51 and other features like it were actually galaxies. Spiral galaxy M51 (NGC 5194), The Whirlpool Galaxy, displays its long arms which consist of stars and gas laced with dust arranged in long lanes, in this view from the Hubble Space Telescope.

articles.title: 'We basically did Top Gun in space': 'Star Trek Starfleet Academy' warps back into action in March 2027 for sophomore year in the final frontier
articles.excerpt: The sophomore season of "Star Trek: Starfleet Academy" will warp back to the small screen in March 2027 when the limited series returns for its final season on Paramount+.
articles.body: NEW YORK — Set your phasers to back-to-school, space fans. Star Trek is going back to Starfleet Academy for season 2, and we finally have a release date. The sophomore season of " Star Trek: Starfleet Academy " will warp back to the small screen in March 2027 when the limited series returns for its final season on Paramount+ . The series, which follows a class of cadets balancing Starfleet classes, space adventures (and yes, some love) in the 32nd century, will return with its full cast and even add new faces, showrunners announced at a panel at New York Comic Con 2026 on Saturday (Oct. 10). "Season one is about letting go of who you were in the past to start again at Starfleet Academy," executive producer and co-showrunner Noga Landau said in the Star Trek panel.
articles.author: Tariq Malik

articles.title: See the original Galileo shuttle from 'Star Trek' in its new home at the Original Series Set Tour in New York
articles.excerpt: This iconic spaceship will now live long and prosper in its brand-new Star Trek Tour home.
articles.body: Nostalgia is a hell of a thing, especially when it comes to sci-fi. For "Star Trek" fans wanting to mark the franchise's 60th anniversary this year, a geeky pilgrimage to upstate New York should be on the cards. Why? Because alongside the splendid autumnal colors, they can steer over to Ticonderoga to behold the newly installed Galileo shuttlecraft. After a complete two-year restoration project in 2012 headed up by superfan and collector Adam Schneider, this iconic fictional spacecraft, seen by millions in seven episodes over three seasons of "Star Trek: The Original Series," was recently relocated from its former home at the Johnson Space Center Museum in Houston, Texas.
